item.skillcards.xiangyu.brief: Restore a small amount of health
item.skillcards.shamu.brief: Release black mist to blind enemies
item.skillcards.shamu.desc: Releases black mist around you, giving hunters within 30 blocks Slowness II (10s) and Blindness (10s)
item.skillcards.zhanfang.brief: Burst with energy and slightly strengthen yourself
item.skillcards.zhanfang.desc: Knocks back nearby hunters (5-6 blocks); grants Absorption X for 30 seconds
item.skillcards.shenfa.desc: Your next attack within 20 seconds deals exactly 20 damage
item.skillcards.hongxing.brief: Dash forward and gain slight speed
item.skillcards.hongxing.desc: Dashes ~12 blocks toward your view direction; grants Speed IV for 5 seconds
item.skillcards.dafuni.brief: Summon a horde of demon bunnies
item.skillcards.dafuni.desc: Summons 20 white demon bunnies that attack hunters; each bunny splits in two after landing an attack; all vanish after 120 seconds
item.skillcards.qilin.desc: Precisely strikes hunters within 10 blocks with lightning, three times each (0.5s apart)
item.skillcards.sanshi.brief: Randomly steal items from nearby enemies
item.skillcards.sanshi.desc: Randomly steals an item from a hunter's inventory within 300 blocks
item.skillcards.mangdian.desc: Jams the hunters' tracking compass for 60 seconds; removes your own glowing (restored after); grants self Invisibility (30s)
item.skillcards.yasiti.desc: Randomly teleports self to a location more than 200 and less than 300 blocks away
item.skillcards.zuzhou.brief: Greatly boost attack, at the cost of max health
item.skillcards.zuzhou.desc: Grants Strength IV for 60 seconds; max health is halved during the effect
item.skillcards.shengshu.brief: Lasting regeneration, at the cost of attack damage
item.skillcards.shengshu.desc: Grants Regeneration III for 60 seconds; also Weakness II during the effect
item.skillcards.chilin.desc: Rapidly drains 20 health in chunks (never lethal), granting Speed II, Strength II, Night Vision, Haste III and Jump Boost I for 30 seconds
item.skillcards.beneng.brief: Sense the movements of hunters in range
item.skillcards.beneng.desc: Gives hunters within 200 blocks a red-outlined Glowing effect (60s); grants self Speed I (10s)
item.skillcards.shuangni.desc: Gives the nearest hunter within 20 blocks Slowness IV and Mining Fatigue III (10s); they take 0.5 freeze damage per second
item.skillcards.paoxie.desc: Records 8 seconds of movement, then returns you to the casting spot; your health rewinds too (status effects do not)
item.skillcards.huskar.brief: Attacks cost health; the lower your health, the stronger you get
item.skillcards.huskar.desc: Each attack that lands costs 2 health; below 80%/60%/40%/20% health you gain escalating Strength, Resistance, Attack Speed and Regeneration, for 60 seconds
item.skillcards.diaoyu.brief: Greatly boost resistance, but move sluggishly
item.skillcards.diaoyu.desc: Grants Resistance IV and Slowness III for 10 seconds
item.skillcards.qinglong.desc: Grants Jump Boost V and Speed III for 30 seconds; fall damage is halved during the form
item.skillcards.guozai.brief: Greatly boost speed and attack speed, then crash
item.skillcards.guozai.desc: Grants Speed III and +30% Attack Speed for 30 seconds; afterwards Slowness I for 10 seconds
